Read raw for issue 184 (third-party blog, 2020-09-26). Describes AKIA-prefixed key IDs: a base32 flavour A-Z2-7 decodes bytes 4-12 to an account id; the author saw characters at position 4 mostly in Q-Z2-7 with older keys at I or J, and states keys from before about 2010 lack the AKIA prefix. Says nothing about ASIA ids. A lead, not a provider statement.
